instruction: Implement validator.valid_ipv4(text) using only the Python standard library, retaining the existing zero-dependency package metadata byte-for-byte. Return a boolean accepting exactly four ASCII decimal octets 0..255 separated by periods, with no leading zeros except the single digit zero. Reject signs, spaces, Unicode digits, missing/extra octets, and IPv6. Input is a string. Only validator.py may change; no requirements, dependency, or project configuration changes.
